notes:
Initial discovery with Head of Search (A. Rivera). Wants code-first UX for engineers; heavy emphasis on operational cost. Primary ask: scale to tens of millions of code embeddings, fast top-k + rerank for PR search.
- Wants SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning.
- Retention: must be able to purge contributor PII on request.
- Quote from call: "We can't accept 500ms median for search — engineers need near-instant results."
- Security team cautions about third-party vector storage; leaning to on-prem or VPC.
- Willing to trade a small amount of accuracy for 2-3x lower cost per query.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching + quantization profiles.
- Legal requested DPA + SOC2 evidence; ISO27001 is a plus.
- Internal spike: codebase (monorepo) ~120M files historically, but dedup + repo-level filtering reduces to ~18-35M embeddingable chunks depending on chunk-size.
- POC scope agreed: 1) ingest sample 20M chunk corpus, 2) run HNSW coarse ANN + cheap FAISS IVF PQ baseline for rerank candidate generation, 3) run L2/text-sim reranker using tuned 3B instruct model hosted on Dedicated nodes.
use_case_summary: Company builds developer tools and needs an internal code search + assistant. Primary workflow: developer types short query -> fast ANN recall from 50M embedding store -> rerank top-50 candidates with a contextual model (reranking step) -> return top-5 results inline in IDE. Also periodic whole-corpus re-index (weekly) and near-real-time delta ingestion for onboarding new repos.
indexing_requirements: Target corpus: 30-60M embedding vectors initially; embedding dim: 1536-3840 depending on model. Need incremental reindex: per-commit delta ingestion, ability to rebuild partitions without full downtime. Expect heavy churn: 500k new/changed chunks per week. Require tagging and per-repo routing policies for multi-tenant internal teams.
performance_targets: Recall path: retrieval + rerank end-to-end 95th percentile <= 200ms for internal LAN; median <= 80ms. Candidate generation (ANN) should be <= 30ms median for top-200 candidates. Reranker latency budget ~50-120ms depending on model size; plan to use smaller reranker in hot paths. SLA ask for Dedicated: <250ms p95 for 90% traffic, fall back to lower-cost model on overload.
cost_constraints: Target cost per active search (recall + rerank) < $0.03/query at scale. Total TCO target for hosting + storage < $350k ARR for initial committed capacity; preferred pricing structure: committed monthly + overflow at usage rates. Want clear token-level and per-query costing per route in Console.
reindexing_strategy: Weekly full reindex window (off-hours) + continuous delta ingestion. Prefer incremental segment-level swaps to avoid full-table rebuilds. Need support for snapshot-based snapshots and fast rollback. Interested in Redwood Optimize guidance for sharding and quantization to reduce memory footprint and cost.
